svg.title: DorkOS systems and deployment boundaries
svg.desc: The app reaches the local server. The space server is a second entry and image target of the same server package, with its own Postgres and sign-in. Cloud space management uses a separate public contract; rollout is independent of local implementation. Marketplace discovery and installation use the same package sources. The hub and agent-computer roles of the same program are omitted here; see the roles view.
